description: Fires when the opponent has a vertical run on top of column 0 (the leftmost column) with the cell above still empty: strongly (act 4-20) for an open vertical three in column 0 (a must-block), weakly (about 1-3) for an opponent pair at rows 2-3 of column 0 with column 0 exactly four high. The same threats in other columns, my own stones, and pairs at other heights do not make it fire.
effect: Supports blocking the column-0 vertical threat: zeroing it cuts the model's probability of playing column 0 by up to about 25-43 points in some threat positions (little change when the block is already certain or an own win exists); forcing it high elsewhere has small, inconsistent effects.
notes: Open vertical three in col 0 alone: precision 0.995, recall 0.33 (F1 0.49). Adding their row-2-3 pair (h0==4): F1 0.682 (P 0.90, R 0.55), sim share 1.52. Adding my own pairs (F1 0.65) or a ply cap / bottom pairs (F1 0.43) hurt. Minimal pairs: col 6/3/1 threats give ~0; pairs at rows 1-2 or 3-4 are negative. Remaining misses are diffuse weak activations (0.5-1.5), often an opponent stone on top of column 0; late-game pairs sometimes stay below threshold. All 5 synthesis positions beat the dev max (best 19.9).
